runtimeNotes.finding: GVM module runtime version and SDK tool version are distinct; this text describes runtime backwards compatibility.
Three timers; handlers are serialized via an event queue; long-running work delays subsequent timeouts.
GVM1X/2X code, symbol, media and workspace limits are discussed separately from the planned GVM3X changes.
Exception categories include invalid opcode, but these pages do not give opcode0xc4 semantics or a numeric opcode map.
Audio device interfaces, VDI master/local palettes, CopyImagePal/SetPalette and SaveLCD/RestoreLCD background workflow.
GVM1X/2X have no key-release event and do not continuously repeat key events while held; long-press handling differs across manufacturers.
